name: Biome CLI v2.6.4
body: ## 2.6.4 ### Patch Changes - [#12261](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12261) [`19fbfb2`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/19fbfb2311b5dc4bf1b6ee8dd5b258d9699436a5) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`noConsoleSpaces`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-console-spaces/), which reports a leading or trailing space in a `console.log()`, `console.debug()`, `console.info()`, `console.warn()`, or `console.error()` argument that sits next to another argument. These methods already put a space between arguments, so such a space prints twice. ```js console.log("abc ", "def"); ``` - [#12469](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12469) [`cd716d3`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/cd716d38575ce603d8cddbabec97b3d52463858b) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`noMagicArrayFlatDepth`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-magic-array-flat-depth/), which reports number literals other than `1` passed as the depth of `Array.prototype.flat()` unless a comment inside the parentheses explains them. ```js const items = array.flat(2); ``` - [#12470](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12470) [`92c9e81`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/92c9e81bd7c767b4b3e583a312f75c0f364298dd) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noNull`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-null/), which reports uses of the `null` literal and suggests `undefined` instead. Strict comparisons such as `foo === null` are allowed. ```js let foo = null; ``` - [#12483](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12483) [`9bd3527`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/9bd35277c99fffa6b252a594a2a74e553e977b3b) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noReturnArrayPush`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-return-array-push/), which reports code that uses the return value of `push()` or `unshift()`. These methods return the new length of the array, not the added item or the array. ```js function add(item) { return items.push(item); } ``` - [#12477](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12477) [`a384892`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/a384892c6b9f882b9c1751bf725cb84d9c8738b6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noUnreadableIife`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unreadable-iife/), which reports arrow functions that are called right where they are defined and whose body is wrapped in parentheses. ```js const foo = (bar => (bar ? bar.baz : baz))(getBar()); ``` - [#12447](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12447) [`0a963e4`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/0a963e4a30cfb550e0994bd925d16391e725bf4f) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noUselessRecursion`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-useless-recursion/), which reports functions that return a call to themselves when a loop can do the same work. Too many nested calls can crash the program with a stack overflow error. ```js function findRoot(node) { if (node.parent) { return findRoot(node.parent); } return node; } ``` - [#12554](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12554) [`2eddda9`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/2eddda9046fc36aa5ef455d8fd57b2900b7dc319) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueComputedPropertiesInData`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-computed-properties-in-data/), which reports computed properties used inside the `data` function of a Vue component. Vue runs `data` before it sets up computed properties, so the value read there is `undefined`. ```vue ``` - [#12586](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12586) [`824df15`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/824df15e1e7c4bd433c3efaa999c4aa3e495c625) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueDeprecatedDeleteSet`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-deprecated-delete-set/), which reports calls to the `$set` and `$delete` functions, `Vue.set` and `Vue.delete`, and `set` and `del` imported from `vue`. Vue 3 removed these functions, so calling them throws an error. ```vue ``` - [#12648](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12648) [`6fc1a51`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/6fc1a51e9e9493c6519892e10478d2e1fdf226db) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueDeprecatedRouterLinkTagProp`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-deprecated-router-link-tag-prop/), which disallows the `tag` prop on `RouterLink`. Vue Router 4 ignores this prop, so the link still renders as an `` element. ```vue ``` - [#12631](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12631) [`de1188f`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/de1188fce7bd6205361225ae53c6dc32d16f3600) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`noVueDeprecatedScopeAttribute`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-deprecated-scope-attribute/), which reports the `scope` attribute on `
